# Load packages and datasets

```{r, message = F}
library(tidyverse)

d3_instLevel = read_csv("../clean_data/d3_instLevel_ds.csv")
d3_sports = read_csv("../clean_data/d3_sports_ds.csv")
d3_coach = read_csv("../clean_data/d3_coach_ds.csv")

d3_sports = d3_sports %>%
  mutate(
    institution_name = case_when(
      institution_name == "Linfield College" ~ "Linfield University",
      institution_name == "Linfield College-McMinnville Campus" ~ "Linfield University",
      .default = institution_name
    )
  )

d3_instLevel = d3_instLevel %>%
  mutate(
    institution_name = case_when(
      institution_name == "Linfield College-McMinnville Campus" ~ "Linfield University",
      .default = institution_name
    )
  )

d3_coach = d3_coach %>%
  mutate(
    institution_name = case_when(
      institution_name == "Linfield College" ~ "Linfield University",
      .default = institution_name
    )
  )

nwc = c(
  "Linfield University", "George Fox University", "Whitworth University", "Whitman College", "Pacific University", "University of Puget Sound", "Pacific Lutheran University", "Lewis & Clark College"
)

```

# EDA plots

## Plot 1: Operating Expenses vs Number of Athletes

* Geometries: Points, ABline, text
* Aesthetics: x = number of athletes, y = operating expenses, color = type of school

```{r}
selected_sport = "Men's Football"
selected_year = 2025

title = paste0("Divison III ", selected_sport, " Operating Expenses vs Number of Athletes in ", as.numeric(selected_year))

ds = d3_sports %>%
  filter(sport == selected_sport, year == selected_year) %>%
  mutate(
    color = case_when(
      institution_name %in% nwc ~ "Northwest Conference",
      institution_name == "Willamette University" ~ "Willamette University",
      .default = "Division III"
    )
  )

colorpal = c(
  "Willamette University" = "darkred",
  "Northwest Conference" = "blue",
  "Division III" = "black"
)


solid = ds %>%
  filter(institution_name %in% nwc | institution_name == "Willamette University")


ds %>%
  filter(!(institution_name %in% nwc), !(institution_name == "Willamette University")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n_athletes, y = op_exp, color = color)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .1) +
  geom_point(data = solid, aes(x = n_athletes, y = op_exp, color = color), size = 2) +
  geom_text(data = solid, aes(label = institution_name), hjust = -.1, size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = median(ds$op_exp, na.rm = TRUE)/median(ds$n_athletes), color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colorpal) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max(ds$n_athletes)), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function (x) paste0(x/1000, "k"), limits = c(0, max(ds$op_exp)), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = title,
    subtitle = "Dashed line = median operating expense per athlete",
    x = "Number of Athletes",
    y = "Operating Expenses ($)",
    color = "Institution"
  )
```

Analysis

## Plot 2: Operating Expenses per Athlete by Year

* Geometries: Points, smooth line
* Aesthetics: x = year, y = operating expenses per athlete, color = type of school

```{r, warning = F, message = F}
selected_sport = "Men's Football"

title = paste0("Willamette Consistently Spends Less per Athlete for ", selected_sport)

points = d3_sports %>%
  filter(sport == selected_sport, institution_name %in% nwc)
  
willamette = d3_sports %>%
  filter(sport == selected_sport, institution_name == "Willamette University")
  
  
  
points %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = op_exp_per_athlete)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .4, aes(color = "Other NWC Schools")) +
  geom_smooth(se = F, alpha = .5, aes(color = "Other NWC Schools")) +
  geom_point(data = willamette, aes(x = year, y = op_exp_per_athlete, color = "Willamette University")) +
  geom_smooth(data = willamette, se = F, aes(color = "Willamette University")) +
  theme_light() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Willamette University" = "darkred",
      "Other NWC Schools" = "grey70"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = title,
    subtitle = "Compared with other Northwest Conference schools",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Operating Expense per Athlete ($)",
    color = "Institution"
  )
```

## Plot 3: Operating Expenses per Athlete by School

* Geometries: Points, boxplot
* Aesthetics: x = school, color = type of school

```{r, warning = F, message = F}
d3_sports %>%
  filter(institution_name %in% nwc | institution_name == "Willamette University") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(institution_name, op_exp_per_athlete, .fun = median), y = op_exp_per_athlete)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = institution_name == "Willamette University",
        group = institution_name), alpha = .2, position = "jitter") +
  geom_boxplot(aes(color = institution_name == "Willamette University", group = institution_name), alpha = 0) +
  theme_light() +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "Willamette University" = "WU", "University of Puget Sound" = "UPS", "Lewis & Clark College" = "L&C", "Pacific Lutheran University" = "PLU", "Pacific University" = "Pacific", "Whitworth University" = "Whitworth", "George Fox University" = "GFU", "Linfield University" = "Linfield", "Whitman College" = "Whitman"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "darkred", "FALSE" = "gray70"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Amount Spent per Athlete",
    title = "How Spoiled Are Athletes?",
    subtitle = "$(USD) spent on individual athletes by school"
  )
```

## Plot 4: Headcoach Salary vs Year

* Geometries: Lines
* Aesthetics: x = year, y = head coach salaries, color = type of school

```{r}
d3_instLevel %>%
  mutate(HC_sal = HDCOACH_SAL_FTE_MEN+HDCOACH_SAL_FTE_WOMN) %>%
  filter(institution_name %in% nwc| institution_name == "Willamette University")%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = HC_sal)) + 
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha = .6, aes(color = institution_name == "Willamette University",
        group = institution_name)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2016,2018,2020,2022,2024))+
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "darkred", "FALSE" = "gray70"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "Willamette", "FALSE" = "Other NWC")
  )+
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title ="Who Splurgles on Head Coaches?",
    subtitle = "Total NWC HC salaries across years",
    y = "Cumulative Head Coach Salaries ($)",
    x = "Year",
    color = "School"
  )
```

## Plot 5: Percent Difference in Expense Categories from NWC Median

* Geometries: Columns, vline
* Aesthetics: x = difference in percentage, y = expense category, fill = positive/negative

```{r}
expense_breakdown = d3_instLevel %>%
  filter(institution_name %in% nwc | institution_name == "Willamette University") %>%
  mutate(
    hc_salaries =
      coalesce(HDCOACH_SALARY_MEN * NUM_HDCOACH_MEN, 0) +
      coalesce(HDCOACH_SALARY_WOMEN * NUM_HDCOACH_WOMEN, 0) +
      coalesce(HDCOACH_SALARY_COED * NUM_HDCOACH_COED, 0),

    ac_salaries =
      coalesce(ASCOACH_SALARY_MEN * NUM_ASCOACH_MEN, 0) +
      coalesce(ASCOACH_SALARY_WOMEN * NUM_ASCOACH_WOMEN, 0) +
      coalesce(ASCOACH_SALARY_COED * NUM_ASCOACH_COED, 0),

    recruiting =
      coalesce(RECRUITEXP_MEN, 0) +
      coalesce(RECRUITEXP_WOMEN, 0) +
      coalesce(RECRUITEXP_COED, 0),

    operating = IL_TOTAL_OPEXP_INCLCOED,
    
    other = GRND_TOTAL_EXPENSE - operating - recruiting - hc_salaries - ac_salaries
  )


selected_year = 2025
title = paste0("Where Willamette's Athletic Spending Differed in ", selected_year)

expense_breakdown %>%
  filter(year == selected_year) %>%
  mutate(
    operating = operating / GRND_TOTAL_EXPENSE * 100,
    recruiting = recruiting / GRND_TOTAL_EXPENSE * 100,
    hc_salaries = hc_salaries / GRND_TOTAL_EXPENSE * 100,
    ac_salaries = ac_salaries / GRND_TOTAL_EXPENSE * 100,
    other = other / GRND_TOTAL_EXPENSE * 100
  ) %>%
  select(
    institution_name,
    operating,
    recruiting,
    hc_salaries,
    ac_salaries,
    other
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -institution_name,
    names_to = "category",
    values_to = "percentage"
  ) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  mutate(
    nwc_median = median(
      percentage[institution_name %in% nwc],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(institution_name == "Willamette University") %>%
  mutate(
    difference = percentage - nwc_median,
    category = recode(
      category,
      operating = "Operating expenses",
      recruiting = "Recruiting",
      hc_salaries = "Head coach salaries",
      ac_salaries = "Assistant coach salaries",
      other = "Other expenses"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = difference, y = reorder(category, difference), fill = difference > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = \(x) paste0(x, " pp")
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = title,
    subtitle = "Difference in budget share from the NWC median",
    x = "Difference in percentage points",
    y = ""
  )
```
